description_en: Executes an operation synchronously to manage resources in an application
description_zh: 维护应用下资源API（同步操作）
kebab_example: aliyun bpstudio execute-operation-sync --application-id BE68D71ZY5YYIU9R --service-type dds --operation rename --attributes key=example-string --resource-group-id rg-acfmyjt3c5om3hi --client-token 1600765710019 --api-version 2021-09-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteOperationSync

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Architect Design Tools (CADT) application
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. For example, to perform an operation on a DDS resource, set this parameter to dds
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，例如需要执行 dds 这一资源的操作请填写：dds
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en: The parameters for the operation. The parameters that you must specify vary based on the value of Operation
parameters.help_zh: 操作相关参数，根据不同的Operation值，输入对应的参数
parameters.name: attributes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. This ID is used for permission verification
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，用于资源组权限校验
parameters.name: resource_group_id
